questions.statement: Tạo class Rectangle trong package model với: private double width, private double height; constructor public Rectangle(double width, double height); getArea() trả về width * height; setWidth(double) ném IllegalArgumentException khi giá trị âm; toString() trả về Rectangle{width=<width>, height=<height>}; Rectangle implements Comparable<Rectangle>, so sánh theo diện tích tăng dần.

questions.title: Employee Class (Java Reflection)
questions.statement: Create a class Employee in package model with: private String employeeId, private String name, private double salary; public constructor Employee(String employeeId, String name, double salary); getSalary() returns the current salary; giveRaise(double percentage) increases salary by the given percentage and returns the updated salary; throw IllegalArgumentException if the percentage is negative; toString() returns Employee{employeeId=<employeeId>, name=<name>, salary=<salary>}; Employee implements Comparable<Employee>, comparing by salary in ascending order.

questions.title: Book Class (Java Reflection)
questions.statement: Create a class Book in package model with: private String isbn, private String title, private double price; public constructor Book(String isbn, String title, double price); getPrice() returns the current price; applyDiscount(double percentage) reduces the price by the given percentage and returns the updated price; throw IllegalArgumentException if the percentage is less than 0 or greater than 100; toString() returns Book{isbn=<isbn>, title=<title>, price=<price>}; Book implements Comparable<Book>, comparing by price in ascending order.
